description:
Letter to a dignitary. Concerning travel and business transactions, including in military gear and enslaved people. 

Alternate readings (ASE):
- instead of الحتة in r10 it is possible to read الجبة (jubba, "sleeved garment"), as in doc. 37 (PGPID 40709).

Khan, Qaṣr Ibrīm, doc. 31
description_he: מכתב לנכבד; עוסק בנסיעות ועסקאות כולל ציוד צבאי ועבדים (Khan, Qaṣr Ibrīm, doc. 31)
